visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a light pink turtleneck sweater, points toward an overlay image of skin with stretch marks in an office setting with shelves and awards in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the woman speaking enthusiastically, with dynamic black-and-white radiating lines appearing around her for emphasis. (3) A sequence shows close-ups of red and purple stretch marks on different skin areas, followed by a demonstration of a medical laser device being applied to a person's abdomen. (4) Split-screen before-and-after photos of skin with purple marks are displayed, showing significant fading. (5) The woman returns to the frame, discussing white stretch marks while pointing at a new overlay image; animated gold coins fall from the top of the frame. (6) A transition to a woman applying cream to a pregnant belly in a brightly lit indoor environment, followed by shots of skincare products like Neogence squalane and CeraVe moisturizing cream. (7) Text lists for prevention and improvement strategies appear on screen over a light background. (8) The video concludes with a white end screen displaying the clinic's logo, contact number, and addresses in Taipei.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, energetic female voice speaking in a professional yet friendly tone. A steady, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM kicks in immediately. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effects occur as the visual scene shifts to medical close-ups. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to emphasize technical terms. (3) A distinct metallic jingling sound, resembling falling coins, is layered over the speech as the visual of gold coins appears. (4) The speaker continues with a high-density explanation of skincare ingredients, maintaining high arousal and clarity. (5) Occasional bell-like 'ding' SFX highlight list items on screen. (6) The BGM remains consistent until a final fade-out as the voice concludes the informative segment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Problem Identification -> Solution A (Medical) -> Solution B (Skincare) -> Prevention -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate women, particularly mothers, on the different types of stretch marks and how to treat or prevent them using both professional medical procedures and specific skincare products, while promoting the DRX Dermatology Clinic.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging (Neogence, CeraVe) and clinic contact information at the end.
